t: CAMP RANKIN CELEBRATES 50TH ANNIVERSARY | Farms.com
s: Camp Rankin is 4-H Nova Scotia’s provincial summer camp in Richmond County, Cape Breton. Camp Rankin is a co-ed, week-long, overnight camp for youth aged 9 to 12, including those who are not 4-H members. Campers enjoy hiking trails and a beach as staff lead campers through 4-H skills sessions and traditional camp activities such as crafts, recreation, canoeing, drama, and nature.
